themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are leveraging polling gains and parliamentary friction to position themselves as central power brokers. In Spain and Sweden, conservative leaders face intense negotiations over coalition terms, while French and German far-right figures attempt to convert steady electoral momentum into formal governance roles.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Positioned as an essential coalition partner for the PP ahead of the November 29 snap election, demanding cabinet seats and policy concessions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Signals willingness to tolerate Ulf Kristersson's prime ministerial vote while using its parliamentary weight to force concessions from moderate parties.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen maintains strong presidential polling leads for 2027 while mobilizing party infrastructure to fend off rival right-wing contenders.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Sustains high polling figures while exploring formal cooperation agreements with opposition factions in state assemblies.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements in multiple democracies are framing ongoing judicial inquiries, law enforcement raids, and electoral disqualification efforts as coordinated political persecution. Leaders in Brazil, France, the US, Germany, and Poland cite institutional bias to rally their activist bases against state oversight.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces multiple court challenges regarding party congress bans and municipal election rules alongside renewed ban petitions.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Far-right factions are unifying around demands for 'national priority' in state services and mass deportation policies. From Spain to Germany and Norway, populist parties are pushing hardline anti-immigration frames to define electoral debates and challenge liberal asylum standards.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands explicit 'prioridad nacional' and remigration policies as conditions for government support, clashing with election boards over campaign banners.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Party leadership calls for mass deportations of over 2.6 million foreign residents, establishing remigration as a core campaign pillar.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local branches vote against municipal refugee quotas while promoting externalized asylum models modeled on third-country processing.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Federal restrictions targeting non-citizens' access to subsidized housing spark legal challenges from municipal governments.

themes.title: Transnational Conservative Alliances and Bilateral Right-Wing Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders are building bilateral networks to bypass traditional diplomatic channels and project strength internationally. High-profile meetings between South American libertarian figures and European national-conservatives demonstrate an effort to solidify a global right-wing alliance.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are combining tax-cutting promises with fiscal populism to attract working-class voters. Factions in France, Italy, Argentina, Spain, and Norway are debating state spending caps, tax exemptions, and pension reform rollbacks ahead of upcoming legislative sessions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Defends pension reform promises against critics while seeking to reassure voters on long-term fiscal responsibility.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Coalition leaders negotiate youth flat-tax proposals and budget adjustments amid pressure from municipal governments.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Pushes aggressive public sector headcount reductions aiming for multi-billion dollar budget savings.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Pledges sweeping tax cuts, deregulation for agricultural sectors, and the elimination of green energy levies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Campaigns on phasing out local property taxes and capping municipal fiscal burdens.
